description: The earliest age the person could retire with their money lasting to 100 after tax - the Retirement page's Can You Stop sums - today and at the start of the month, then each pension and savings account that moved it and the figures it rests on (payments in, spending, growth), each with a link to see or change it in Foliopeak. Use for 'why did my retirement date move', 'what changed my retirement age', 'can I still retire at 60 and why'. Show the links so the person can check each figure.
name: get_retirement_change
title: Why the retirement age moved
